items: DURABLE SMART WATCH - Designed with sturdy, drop-resistant titanium alloy bezel and stainless steel caseback, the fitness smart watches for men case is carefully polished with fine metal sandblasting and diamond-cutting process, which perfectly connects the body, bezel and caseback to ensure that the rugged tactical watch is waterproof, sturdy and reliable. Passing strict military tests, including salt spray, rain, impact, 30 meters waterproof, it can easily face any harsh environment

FOCUSING ON YOUR HEALTH - The smart watches for men is equipped with high-precision sensors for accurate monitoring. Effectively monitoring heart rate, blood oxygen and blood pressure, and you can turn on all-day heart rate and stress monitoring in the APP, and set up heart rate warning reminders. The fitness watch also monitors sleep and provides sleep trends for the last seven days, analyzing your health in real time and helping to adjust a healthy lifestyle(Note: The health data can only be used as a reference for exercise and cannot be compared with professional medical equipment data)

SPORTS & FITNESS TRACKING WATCH - The men's smart watch has 124 indoor and outdoor exercise modes, customized for you who love sports. The fitness tracker can automatically track steps, distance, calories and more. Connect “Da Fit” APP, you can use your phone GPS to view your exercise track, set exercise goals and view workout records, in addition, you can record your weight in the APP and view the trend of weight change

BLUETOOTH SMARTWATCH - The watches for men is compatible with most phones with iOS 9.0 and Android 6.0 and above. Built-in high-fidelity speaker and microphone, support Bluetooth to make and receive calls, receive message alerts, play music and voice assistant, free your hands from the phone, make communication more free

LARGE CAPACITY BATTERY AND HD DISPLAY - The android smart watch built-in 410mAh high-capacity battery, charging for 2 hours, support 7-10 days of daily use, 45 days standby. 1.52-inch colorful HD display, even in harsh sunlight is also clearly visible, with a cool creative watch face, to provide a variety of visual experience, highlighting the fashion trend, you can match and customize your watch face

MULTIFUNCTIONAL SMART WATCH - This military smart watches for men has many functions, such as breathing training, APP reminder, sedentary reminder, water reminder, wake up alarm, stopwatch, timer, weather forecast, music playback and control, camera control, find phone, calendar, calculator and so on, it is a little helper in your daily life
NOTE - The health data can only be used as a reference for exercise and cannot be compared with professional medical equipment data
